tasks.label: build
tasks.command: clang-format -i -style=file "${file}" && CXX="${workspaceFolder}/.vscode/g++-for-oj-bundle" uv run oj-bundle -I "${workspaceFolder}/libraries/ei1333" -I "${workspaceFolder}/libraries/nyaan" -I "${workspaceFolder}/libraries/suisen" -I "${workspaceFolder}/libraries/niche-library" "${file}" > "${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.bundle.cpp" && g++ -o "${fileDirname}/a.out" -O3 -std=gnu++23 -I "${workspaceFolder}/libraries/ac-library" -I "${workspaceFolder}/libraries/precompile" -H "${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.bundle.cpp" && sed -i '/^#line/d' "${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.bundle.cpp" && clang-format -i -style=file "${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.bundle.cpp"
